# @kitiumai/cache

> 标签: backup, cache, cache-aside, cache-invalidation, caching, circuit-breaker, connection-pooling, distributed-cache, elasticache, eviction, express, failover, fastify, high-availability, in-memory-cache, key-management, kitium, kitiumai, lfu, loading-cache, lru, metrics, multi-level-cache, multi-region, multi-tenant, nestjs, nodejs, observability, opentelemetry, performance, persistence, profiling, redis, redis-cluster, redis-sentinel, refresh-ahead, resilience, restore, tiny-lfu, tinylfu, tracing, ttl, typescript

## 简介

Production-ready Redis + in-memory cache for Node.js with typed APIs, key management, TTL, eviction strategies (LRU/LFU/TinyLFU), loading cache, clustering, multi-region failover, persistence, tracing, and circuit breaker resilience.
